answer: Require each agent identity to stake a deposit that is slashed on proven duplicate behavior, like a velvet rope admitting only funded participants. A new identity must also complete a unique, time-bound proof-of-useful-work task - an ember kept lit through verifiable computation - before transacting. Peers in the same meadow of counterparties attest only identities whose stake and work check out, so thousands of fakes means locking thousands of deposits and burning real compute per identity, making a sybil flood costlier than any gain.
